channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha conversa com PF e MJ para reclamar de "vazamentos"
item.description: The defense team of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, met with Justice Minister Wellington César Lima e Silva and Federal Police director-general Andrei Rodrigues to complain about leaks of confidential information from the Supreme Court investigations involving President Lula's eldest son. Attorney Marco Aurélio de Carvalho expressed concern over the media exposure of the case and requested updates on the inquiries into the leaks themselves. President Lula had previously met with the lawyer, and Justice André Mendonça ordered the Federal Police to investigate new suspected leaks in a probe examining alleged influence trafficking and mediation of interests linked to cannabidiol-based medicines.

item.title: Empresário do "grupo do golpe" doa para vereador aliado de Paes no Rio
item.description: Businessman Ivan Wrobel, investigated by Federal Police in 2022 for alleged coup-related WhatsApp messages, donated R$ 1,064 to councilman Pedro Duarte (PSD), ally of Eduardo Paes. His son Flávio made identical donation plus R$ 30,000 to PSD state directory. Duarte switched from Novo to PSD in 2026, distancing from Bolsonarism.

item.title: Mulher de Flávio adota cachorro que senador ganhou em comício
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, adopted Chiquinho, a dog he received during his campaign launch rally. The animal was rescued from abuse in July 2026 with support from the Civil Police and Alerj. The adoption was announced in a video classified as electoral propaganda, referencing the Lei Sansão against animal abuse.

item.title: TSE: divergência em filiação não barrava registro de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The technical area of Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) concluded that the inconsistency in Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's party affiliation would not prevent his presidential candidacy registration, despite a system glitch showing him switching from PL to Missão. TSE President Nunes Marques ordered the change disregarded and freed access to the CANDex system, allowing the registration request on August 13. Flávio's defense claims he never requested the party switch.

item.title: Haddad compara casos de Lulinha e Vorcaro e diz que investigações devem ‘ir até o final’
item.description: Fernando Haddad compared the investigations into Lulinha and Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that the two cases are different and advocating for the investigations to proceed to their conclusion. He emphasized that there is no evidence of Lula acting to benefit anyone, while Flávio's case involves contracts and pension fund resources.

item.title: Próximo debate presidencial: data, horário e onde assistir
item.description: The next 2026 presidential debate will take place on September 14th at 10pm, organized by the 'A Hora da Decisão' consortium formed by VEJA and ten other media outlets. Six candidates are confirmed: Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Ronaldo Caiado, Zema, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury. Following this, Record will hold a debate on 09/27 and Globo on 10/01, the last before the first round.

item.title: Governos do Brasil e dos EUA marcam reunião para avançar em negociações sobre tarifaço
item.description: Brazilian Development Minister Márcio Elias Rosa and U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer scheduled a virtual meeting to advance negotiations on U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods. The meeting follows a phone call between Presidents Lula and Trump, who agreed to resume technical talks. Goals include expanding tariff exemptions and discussing reversal of the tariff measures.

item.title: MPE pede impugnação de candidato de Lula por cargo em sindicato do ABC
item.description: The Regional Electoral Prosecutor requested the impugnation of Moisés Selerges' candidacy, former president of the ABC Metalworkers Union, for allegedly missing the incompatibility deadline. The defense argues the union is privately funded, exempting him from the rule, and challenges the lawsuit's timeliness.

item.title: ‘Defesa não é pra quando sobrar dinheiro’, diz Lula em aceno a militares
item.description: Lula advocated for increased Armed Forces investments during the Soldier's Day event, stating defense cannot depend on budget leftovers. The gesture follows a R$ 4.3 billion budget freeze at the Defense Ministry and occurs amid diplomatic tensions with the US over military presence in Latin America.

item.title: Campanha de Lula cria jingle em ofensiva contra Flávio Bolsonaro para espalhar nas redes
item.description: Lula's campaign released an offensive jingle targeting Flávio Bolsonaro, referencing his request for money from Daniel Vorcaro, a R$ 6 million mansion purchase, and the imprisonment of former president Jair Bolsonaro for coup attempt. The song, inspired by a 2016 meme, is distributed via PT-affiliated networks across WhatsApp, Twitter, and TikTok. Flávio's team has not commented.

item.title: Renan Santos vai à evento em SP com Lulinha estampado na camiseta
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos (Missão) wore a T-shirt featuring Lulinha's face with the phrase 'where is the elderly's money?' at the ABDIB 2026 Election Forum in São Paulo, referencing STF investigations against President Lula's eldest son. At the event, Renan criticized the electoral format, the Lula government, the Bolsonaro family, and First Lady Janja, stating Brazil lives in a 'half democracy' based on vote-buying and parliamentary amendment corruption.

item.title: PT abre vaquinha virtual para campanha de Lula
item.description: The PT launched a virtual crowdfunding campaign to finance Lula's reelection bid, accepting donations from R$13 to R$1,064. The funds complement the R$615 million allocated to the party through the Electoral Fund.

item.title: O que Flávio Bolsonaro já disse sobre o caso Dark Horse
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro gave contradictory statements regarding the accountability of the film 'Dark Horse', funded with R$61 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. Flávio is a presidential candidate for the PL party.

item.title: Renan Santos critica emendas: 'Congresso não se importa com nenhum tema nacional', diz
item.description: Renan Santos criticized parliamentary amendments, stating that the National Congress ignores national issues and focuses only on amendments. He advocates for stricter oversight of these funds during a press conference in São Paulo.

item.title: Brasil e EUA marcam nova reunião para falar sobre tarifaço
item.description: Brazil and the US scheduled a virtual meeting for Monday to discuss tariffs imposed by Washington. The meeting follows a phone call between Lula and Trump last week.

item.title: Lula vai faltar à cúpula dos Brics na Índia em setembro
item.description: President Lula will not attend the 18th BRICS summit in New Delhi in September due to the proximity of the Brazilian elections and will be represented by Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira. The meeting marks Xi Jinping's first visit to India in seven years and the return of Vladimir Putin, who avoided Brazil in 2025 due to an ICC arrest warrant.

item.title: Lei Antifacção no STF: juristas e MP debatem impactos em garantias fundamentais
item.description: The STF is debating the Anti-Facilitation Law (Law No. 15.358/2026) in a public hearing, with jurists warning of risks to fundamental rights, such as automatic preventive detention and restrictions on political rights. The Public Prosecutor’s Office is divided: most oppose removing homicide cases linked to criminal organizations from the Jury Court, while others view the law’s electoral impacts favorably.

item.title: A cantora sertaneja que vai na contramão de Ana Castela no campo político
item.description: Brazilian sertanejo music reflects political divides: while Ana Castela faced criticism for appearing with federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG), Lauana Prado stands out for openly embracing left-wing positions, supporting Lula and criticizing Bolsonaro. The singer also openly discusses her bisexuality, opposing the conservative profile dominant in the genre.

item.title: Brasil e EUA retomam negociação sobre tarifaço com reunião na segunda-feira
item.description: Brazil and the US are resuming technical negotiations on the trade tariffs with a virtual meeting scheduled for Monday (31) between Minister Márcio Elias Rosa and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer. The meeting follows a 1h20 phone call between Presidents Lula and Trump, in which Lula requested the resumption of dialogue. Brazil's priority is to expand tariff exemptions — currently at 37.5% for products like footwear, machinery, and sugar — before discussing a full reversal of the measures.

item.title: AGU se prepara para abrir ação contra ministro do STJ condenado por importunação sexual
item.description: The Attorney General's Office is preparing legal action against STJ Minister Marco Buzzi, convicted of sexual harassment. Due to the abolition of compulsory retirement as a sanction, the dismissal must now be approved by the Supreme Court. This marks the first magistrate to lose office under the new legal framework.

item.title: Se pai de Vorcaro doou ao Novo, foi de espontânea vontade, diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) stated that the R$1 million donation made in 2022 by Henrique Moura Vorcaro, father of banker Daniel Vorcaro, to the Novo party's Minas Gerais chapter was made 'of his own free will,' denying any favoritism. The candidate also addressed the Federal Police investigation into Cemig contracts with companies linked to Vorcaro, advocating for a thorough investigation and punishment of those involved, including the already-dismissed director Rubens Soalheiro.

item.title: Durigan diz que combate a supersalários é prioridade contra privilégios
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated that fighting supersalaries in the public sector is a priority of the Lula government to tackle privileges. He noted the review should begin by establishing rules for these payments, especially targeting the Judiciary, the Public Ministry, and the Court of Accounts. Durigan also said progress on the agenda depends on decisions by the Supreme Court.

item.title: Após ligação de Lula a Trump, Brasil marca reunião para a próxima 2ª
item.description: Brazil and the U.S. scheduled a new trade meeting for next Monday (August 31), featuring Brazilian Minister Márcio Elias Rosa and U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer. The date was shifted to accommodate agenda changes. The virtual meeting will focus on tariffs and bilateral trade.

item.title: Zema diz que há “gente” usando a cadeira no STF para fazer negócios
item.description: Romeu Zema, Novo party presidential candidate, stated during a hearing that some STF ministers are using their positions for business dealings. He claimed that in civilized countries these ministers would have already been expelled and would be in an untenable situation.

item.title: Zema mantém críticas a Flávio e diz ser diferente por empreender
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) reiterated his criticisms of Flávio Bolsonaro and emphasized his difference from his rival by being an entrepreneur who never depended on the State, claiming to have donated 100% of his salary as governor. The former governor also defended investigations into the financing of the film 'The Dark Horse' and questioned probes into President Lula's son. Despite the tensions, Zema and Flávio exchanged public gestures of support, including a toast with milk glasses referencing agribusiness.

item.title: Renan diz não se arrepender de ofensas à Janja: ‘Se fosse discreta, não seria alvo de crítica’
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos (Missão) said he does not regret the offenses directed at first lady Janja during a Band TV debate, claiming she would not be a target of criticism if she were more discreet. At a press conference after an ABDIB forum, Renan also wore a t-shirt taunting Lulinha, Lula's son, who is under investigation for INSS benefit fraud. Janja issued a statement calling his remarks misogynistic.

item.title: Salles defende que Zema vá a debates e diz que aliado não cresce em pesquisas por ser ‘contido’
item.description: Ricardo Salles (Novo-SP) criticized Romeu Zema's (Novo) absence from the TV Bandeirantes debate, arguing all candidates should participate regardless of polling position. Salles attributed Zema's low performance (3% in BTG/Nexus) to his 'contained' profile in a belligerent political environment.

item.title: Lula cancela visita a Porto Alegre e planeja ir a Salvador na sexta
item.description: President Lula canceled his visit to Porto Alegre due to bad weather forecasts and redirected his agenda to Salvador, where he plans to hold a walk. The trip to the South was part of a strategy with a new left-wing broad front in Rio Grande do Sul, led by Juliana Brizola.

item.title: Campanha presidencial só esquenta no STF
item.description: The 2026 presidential campaign starts quietly, with Lula and his main opponent avoiding direct confrontation in the first debate. The electoral atmosphere, however, heats up at the Supreme Court (STF), where ongoing investigations could influence the election outcome.

item.title: O recuo estratégico no TSE e o ‘vale-tudo’ digital que ameaça 2026
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques suspended a ruling on deepfake usage in campaigns after losing a virtual vote, creating regulatory uncertainty ahead of the 2026 elections. The delay leaves room for a 'free-for-all' digital environment as rules against inauthentic AI simulations remain undefined.

item.title: Por que nem todo candidato pode usar 'Lula' e 'Bolsonaro' nos nomes de urna
item.description: Brazilian Regional Electoral Courts (TREs) are blocking candidates from using "Lula" and "Bolsonaro" as ballot names for the 2026 elections, based on TSE rules prohibiting voter confusion. Deputy Hélio Lopes (PL) had "Hélio Bolsonaro" vetoed in his Senate race in Roraima, following a 2024 precedent involving "Negona do Bolsonaro". Decisions are made case by case to avoid imbalance in the election.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que, caso seja eleito, irá corrigir distorções da reforma tributária
item.description: Renan Santos stated support for the approved tax framework but proposed correcting distortions and removing exemptions in the new structure. His remarks were made at the ABDIB Fórum Eleições 2026 in São Paulo.

item.title: Zema diz que pretende fatiar Petrobras e BB para viabilizar privatização
item.description: Novo presidential candidate Romeu Zema advocated for splitting Petrobras and Banco do Brasil into segments to enable their privatization. The strategy involves dividing the state-owned companies into smaller parts to facilitate private sector sales.

item.title: Há uma agenda de sabotagem ao licenciamento ambiental, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from Missão to the Presidency of Brazil, claims there is a sabotage agenda targeting environmental licensing and advocates reforms to streamline procedures. He criticizes bureaucracy and pushes for changes benefiting the productive sector.

item.title: Na corrida eleitoral entre Lula e Flávio, quem leva vantagem na disputa Lulinha x ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: The cases involving Lulinha and the film Dark Horse may be used by both sides in the Lula vs. Flávio race to deepen polarization. Columnist Robson Bonin notes that the Lulinha case is easier to exploit politically, while Dark Horse requires more explanation to voters.

item.title: Dark Horse: o que falta para o filme ser exibido nos cinemas do Brasil
item.description: The film Dark Horse, about Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 campaign, has received the Foreign Work Registration (ROE) from Ancine but is still not cleared for Brazilian theaters. Distributor Europa Filmes must request the Title Registration Certificate (CRT) and then the age rating from the Ministry of Justice, with no timeline set for either step.

item.title: A decisão da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre a ida ao debate da Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign decided he will only participate in the Globo debate if President Lula is present, fearing he would become the main target of other right-wing candidates otherwise. Although Flávio wanted to attend, his team's strategy prevailed, as it did in blocking his participation in the Band debate.

item.title: O ‘aliado que não é aliado’: como Eduardo Paes pode ajudar Lula e flertar com eleitor de Flávio
item.description: Eduardo Paes can be a strategic ally for Lula in Rio de Janeiro, offering a non-partisan endorsement while maintaining autonomy to attract voters from Flávio Bolsonaro. Columnist Robson Bonin highlights that Paes does not fully subordinate himself to Lula's campaign, enabling a broader voter outreach strategy in the state.

item.title: Vice de Cleitinho faz aceno a Marcelo Aro e pede votos para senador
item.description: Cleitinho's running mate, Luiz Eduardo Falcão (Republicanos), attended the campaign launch of federal deputy Nely Aquino (Podemos), an ally of Senate candidate Marcelo Aro (PP), and asked for votes for Aro. This contrasts with the official stance of the União Progressista federation, which supports Governor Mateus Simões's (PSD) reelection and avoids a formal alliance with Aro. Cleitinho's allies avoid closeness with Aro to maintain relations with other Senate candidates like Carlos Viana (PSD), while Aro's group presses for the partnership to leverage Cleitinho's polling lead.

item.title: Caiado sobre negociar tarifaço com EUA: "Vou resgatar o Itamaraty"
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated he intends to 'rescue Itamaraty' (Brazil's Foreign Ministry) to negotiate the US tariff hike, criticizing President Lula for making 'provocations' against Donald Trump. He also mentioned other trade barriers, such as Brazil's exclusion from the EU list, which will ban meat, dairy, and egg exports starting September 3 due to sanitary issues. Caiado argued that Brazil's foreign service must be able to negotiate and that the country should not remain 'kidnapped' by a single market.

item.title: Zema diz que pretende fatiar Petrobras e Banco do Brasil para viabilizar privatização
item.description: Romeu Zema proposes splitting Petrobras and Banco do Brasil to enable privatization, also listing BNDES while keeping Caixa due to its social role. He advocates changing health and education revenue allocation using demographic criteria, supports federal spending cuts, and fighting fraud in social programs.

item.title: Zema mantém críticas a Flávio Bolsonaro: “Não tiro nada do que disse”
item.description: Romeu Zema reaffirmed his criticism of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and called for a thorough investigation into the Dark Horse film case, urging that anyone involved be arrested. He denied being advised to soften his stance and criticized what he called biased investigations, including those involving Gilmar Mendes and Lula's son.

item.title: Após ligação entre Lula e Trump, Brasil e EUA marcam nova reunião na segunda para negociar tarifaço
item.description: Brazil and the U.S. scheduled a virtual meeting for Monday the 31st between Minister Márcio Elias Rosa (MDIC) and U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to resume technical negotiations on U.S. tariffs. The meeting was made possible after a roughly 1h20 phone call between Presidents Lula and Donald Trump, during which both agreed to reopen bilateral dialogue. Brazil's priority is to expand the list of products exempt from the tariff hike, before later discussing the reversal of the measures.

item.title: Lula deixa entrevista no QG do Exército sem responder perguntas sobre Lulinha e Marcola
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) left an interview at the Army Headquarters without answering journalists' questions about the investigations involving his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, and his former chief of staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, and the potential impact of these cases on his electoral campaign. The move to avoid the press comes amid growing pressure over the two close allies of the president.

item.title: É fundamental estabelecer mandato de ministros dos tribunais superiores, diz Kassab
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of PSD and vice-presidential candidate on Ronaldo Caiado's ticket, defended the need for political and judicial reform in Brazil. Speaking at the Abdib Fórum Eleições 2026 in São Paulo, he stated that establishing term limits for ministers of the superior courts is essential.

item.title: Sakamoto: Flávio Bolsonaro precisa tratar eleitor como cidadão, não otário
item.description: Columnist Leonardo Sakamoto stated on UOL News that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a presidential candidate, must clarify the money request made to former banker Daniel Vorcaro. According to Sakamoto, Flávio cannot treat voters 'like fools' during the electoral campaign.

item.title: Governo arrecada menos de 20% do previsto com dividendos de estatais no 1º semestre
item.description: The government of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) collected slightly less than 20% of the expected amount in dividends from federal state-owned companies in the first half of the year. The poor performance has raised concerns among analysts about the risk of revenue shortfalls, which are crucial for meeting the 2026 fiscal target.

item.title: Deputado do PL divide palanque com governador do PT, e Eduardo reage
item.description: Federal deputy Jonga Bacelar (PL-BA) caused discomfort within the PL leadership by sharing a stage with Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT), who is running for re-election, while wearing a PT number 13 sticker. A faction of the party pushed for his expulsion, forcing the lawmaker to apologize to national president Valdemar Costa Neto. Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) condemned the incident as incompatible with PL's ideological stance, criticizing party leadership for downplaying it, while Bacelar issued a statement reaffirming his support for PL's candidates.

item.title: Moraes aceita pedido de Bolsonaro para filha receber professor em casa
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized a private tutor to visit Jair Bolsonaro's home to give math and chemistry lessons to his youngest daughter, Laura. Bolsonaro is serving a 27-year and 3-month house arrest sentence for leading a coup plot, and his defense must inform the Supreme Court of weekly class schedules for approval. With the 30-day visitation suspension lifted, sons Carlos and Jair Renan may resume visits, while Flávio remains barred for 90 days and Eduardo stays in the United States.

item.title: Sem Lira e JHC, Flávio Bolsonaro é recebido por apoiadores em Maceió
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) was welcomed by supporters at Maceió's airport on his first campaign agenda in the Northeast, notably without the presence of local leaders Arthur Lira (PP) and former mayor JHC (PSDB). Accompanied by his running mate Alfredo Gaspar and PL allies from Alagoas, he is scheduled for a caravan, a closed meeting with candidates, and a gathering with entrepreneurs at the city's Commercial Association.
